description: This file defines a plugin for calculating inter-rater reliability using a weighted Cohen's Kappa that accounts for duration and modifiers. It includes a main function 'run' that processes a DataFrame of coded intervals, computes the reliability metrics between different observers, and outputs results.

methods.name: cohen_kappa_weighted_by_time
methods.description: Computes Cohen's Kappa weighted by time duration with modifiers, returning kappa, observed agreement, expected agreement, and contingency table.
